address: Bidden Road, Upton Grey, RG25 2RL, United Kingdom
bio: ‘The Hodd’ is a characterful pub at the heart of the village, and offers a friendly welcome and charm aplenty with its rustic brickwork, exposed timbers and open fires. Understated menu descriptions belie the skill in the experienced chef’s well-crafted dishes. Be sure to save room for pudding!...
